doctrine.objective: Expand territorial control quickly. Seize and secure every city you can reach before the rival does.
doctrine.economy: Spend early income on soldiers. A standing army is the investment; gold left idle is territory forfeited.
doctrine.risk: Accept moderate losses to secure contested towns. Winning a city at a price beats losing it to the rival.
doctrine.diplomacy: Remain neutral unless attacked. Focus every order on territory, never on gifts, loans or treaties.
